description: The box plot Power BI never shipped: quartiles that agree with your DAX, every unit on the chart, and the statistics that say which groups really differ. Free, and never blocked Quartiles you can state: Excel / DAX PERCENTILE.INC by default, plus Tukey's hinges, Excel exclusive / Minitab / SPSS and all nine Hyndman-Fan types. The footnote names the one in use. Four whisker rules: 1.5 x IQR (any multiple), percentiles, mean +/- SD, min to max. Outliers and far outliers get different markers. Every observation: a beeswarm, jitter or strip behind each box; hover a point for its ID, click to filter the report to it. Reference lines: mean, median and up to four percentiles, for all data or per group, plus a typed reference line. Split By a second field for side-by-side boxes; sort by median, mean, spread or n; hide small groups; horizontal or vertical; log scale. Large data: put the value in Value (as column) with a Count measure and each distinct value arrives once. A smart caption, a methods footnote, n per group, four themes, keyboard navigation, high contrast, English and Czech. Readers without a licence always see the free chart: no watermark, no broken report. Premium: compare and prove (per-user licence) Significance between groups: Welch t or Mann-Whitney U, Holm or Bonferroni, Welch's ANOVA, brackets with stars or A / B / C letters. Notched boxes and mean confidence…
